scientific_integrity: A mathematically exhaustive finite decision certificate is accompanied by a proof of the recurrence invariant, a conductor-tail closure argument, full Apéry data, and independent implementations using membership dynamic programming and residue shortest paths. No numerical extrapolation is used.
scientific_limitations: Exact first-occurrence and type classification only for powers 1, 2, 3 and the initial consecutive-triple threshold. No arbitrary-power growth classification or global uniqueness across arbitrary generating sets is asserted. Originality is a best-knowledge comparison, not independently certified.
title: First delayed symmetry failure among products of consecutive-triple numerical semigroups
